If your tracking number isn’t updating, this can happen while the courier processes the package. It may take a few days after the shipping label is created for the first scan to appear. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days for the first tracking update.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s website.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the shipment status.
Tracking systems can sometimes lag due to courier scanning delays, high shipping volumes, or temporary system backlogs.
